newsitem.title: MALAYSIA: Malaysia Tenaga says to develop property.
newsitem.headline: Malaysia Tenaga says to develop property.

text.p: Privatised power utility Tenaga Nasional Bhd said it would develop landed properties it owns which it estimates are worth about two billion ringgit, the Business Times reported on Friday.

"Tenaga Nasional Properties (a wholly owned subsidiary of Tenaga) will be developing the landbank either on its own or through joint ventures," the newspaper quoted Tenaga executive chairman Ahmad Tajuddin Ali as saying on Thursday.
He was speaking at a news conference after an excellence award ceremony.
The properties are located in prime locations in Kuala Lumpur as well as in the southern city of Johor Baru and the resort islands of Penang, Pangkor and Langkawi.
Tenaga will initially develop projects worth around one billion ringgit.
The report did not mention a time frame for the developments, and Tenaga officials could not be immediately contacted for comment. ($1 = 2.5 ringgit)
